I went down the street, my scolding coming along with me. Fewer people now, the roads growing quiet. Even so, somewhere the warmth of all that daytime bustle seemed to be hanging on.

en.html:
Hachimangu's rebuilding had not even started. Prince Maidono was still staying at Kenchouji.

Fighting there? Then very probably someone hostile to the court was attacking him. Hardliners in the occupation army, extremists from Rokuhara... plenty of candidates for this work.

The Prince's life was in danger. And not his alone. So many people lived in that area. Here already were people who had fled.

The losses would be terrible.

I had to stop it.

八幡宮の再建はまだ着手もされていない状態だ。
　舞殿宮は相変わらず建朝寺に寄寓する身である。

　その付近で紛争？
　ならば当然、朝廷に敵意を持つ勢力――進駐軍内の
強硬派、六波羅の一部過激派、等々――による舞殿宮
襲撃である確率が高い。

　親王の身が危険だ。
　いやそれに留まらない――あの近辺には住民も多い
のだ。現にこうして避難者がいる。

　甚大な被害が出るだろう。
　
　
　――止めねば。

en.html:
Those deep eyes stopped all the boiling in my head at once.

...And what, exactly, was I going to do?

Jump into the fighting and request everybody to be peaceful? That this would not work for me, I had already learned. Thoroughly.

To stop the fighting, I would have to use force. I could not go easy as I had with those four gangsters the other day. This was probably an armed force. Lives would be taken. Inevitably.

So I would kill the enemy?

Again, that same hypocrisy: protect the good, strike down the evil. Again I would make myself comfortable inside it?

And then, to cancel that hypocrisy, kill some more?

My own side also?

...No. I could not.

There was no way I could.

ja.html:
深い双眸が、沸き立つ思考を一瞬にして鎮めた。

　……俺は、どうしようというのだ。
　争乱の巷に飛び込んで和平を訴えるのか。

　それは俺には無理なのだと、もう思い知ったのに。

　争いを止めるなら、武力を用いるしかない。
　先日、やくざ者四人を相手取った際のように手心を
加えてはいられないだろう――おそらく武装した軍が
相手なのだ。必然、命の奪い合いになる。

　殺すのか。敵を。
　善を守って悪を討つ偽善にまた浸るのか。

　そして偽善を帳消しにする為、更に殺すのか。
　味方をも。

　……できない。
　できる筈がない。
